```json
{
  "summary": "The dbt project already has staging models (stg_atp_tour__matches, stg_atp_tour__players, stg_atp_tour__countries) and a fact table (fct_match), plus dim_date/dim_time, but three mart models declared in _mrt_models.yml were missing .sql implementations: dim_tournament, dim_player, and rpt_match_summary (the final ATP match summary report joining tournaments, players, and match stats). Below are the model definitions needed to complete the project — dim_tournament aggregates tournament-level attributes and match counts from stg_atp_tour__matches (with an 'Unknown' fallback row from ref_unknown_values), dim_player enriches stg_atp_tour__players with country info from stg_atp_tour__countries and career win/loss stats derived from stg_atp_tour__matches, and rpt_match_summary joins fct_match to dim_date, dim_tournament, and dim_player (twice, for winner and loser) to produce one row per match with Date, Tournament, Surface, Round, Winner, Loser, Score, Matches, Aces, Year, and Hand — matching the columns documented in _mrt_models.yml. These should be saved as models/mart/dim_tournament.sql, models/mart/dim_player.sql, and models/mart/rpt_match_summary.sql respectively, then built with `dbt run`.",
  "sql": "-- models/mart/dim_tournament.sql
with matches as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_atp_tour__matches') }}
)
, ref_unknown_record as (
    select * from {{ ref('ref_unknown_values') }}
)
, tournament_agg as (
    select {{ dbt_utils.surrogate_key(['tournament_id', 'tournament_date']) }} as dim_tournament_key
          ,tournament_id
          ,tournament_name
          ,tournament_level
          ,tournament_date
          ,surface
          ,draw_size
          ,count(*) as num_of_matches
      from matches
     group by tournament_id, tournament_name, tournament_level, tournament_date, surface, draw_size
)
, unknown_record as (
    select cast(dim_tournament_key as varchar) as dim_tournament_key
          ,tournament_id
          ,tournament_name
          ,tournament_level
          ,tournament_date
          ,surface
          ,draw_size
          ,num_of_matches
      from tournament_agg

    union all

    select cast(unknown_key as varchar) as dim_tournament_key
          ,unknown_text as tournament_id
          ,unknown_text as tournament_name
          ,unknown_text as tournament_level
          ,unknown_date as tournament_date
          ,unknown_text as surface
          ,unknown_integer as draw_size
          ,unknown_integer as num_of_matches
      from ref_unknown_record
)
select * from unknown_record
;

-- models/mart/dim_player.sql
with players as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_atp_tour__players') }}
)
, countries as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_atp_tour__countries') }}
)
, matches as (
    select * from {{ ref('stg_atp_tour__matches') }}
)
, ref_unknown_record as (
    select * from {{ ref('ref_unknown_values') }}
)
, wins as (
    select winner_id as player_id, count(*) as num_of_wins
      from matches
     group by winner_id
)
, losses as (
    select loser_id as player_id, count(*) as num_of_losses
      from matches
     group by loser_id
)
, player_stats as (
    select p.player_sk as dim_player_key
          ,p.player_id
          ,p.player_name
          ,p.player_name as player_aka
          ,p.first_name
          ,p.last_name
          ,p.dominant_hand
          ,p.date_of_birth
          ,c.nationality
          ,p.country_iso_code
          ,c.country_name
          ,p.height_in_centimeters
          ,p.height_in_inches
          ,coalesce(w.num_of_wins,0) || ' - ' || coalesce(l.num_of_losses,0) as career_wins_vs_losses
          ,case when (coalesce(w.num_of_wins,0)+coalesce(l.num_of_losses,0)) = 0 then 0
                else round(coalesce(w.num_of_wins,0)::decimal / (coalesce(w.num_of_wins,0)+coalesce(l.num_of_losses,0)), 3)
           end as career_win_ratio
          ,coalesce(w.num_of_wins,0) as num_of_wins
          ,coalesce(l.num_of_losses,0) as num_of_losses
      from players p
      left join countries c on p.country_iso_code = c.country_iso_code
      left join wins w on p.player_id = w.player_id
      left join losses l on p.player_id = l.player_id
)
, unknown_record as (
    select cast(dim_player_key as varchar) as dim_player_key, player_id, player_name, player_aka, first_name, last_name,
           dominant_hand, date_of_birth, nationality, country_iso_code, country_name, height_in_centimeters,
           height_in_inches, career_wins_vs_losses, career_win_ratio, num_of_wins, num_of_losses
      from player_stats

    union all

    select cast(unknown_key as varchar) as dim_player_key, unknown_integer as player_id, unknown_text as player_name,
           unknown_text as player_aka, unknown_text as first_name, unknown_text as last_name, unknown_text as dominant_hand,
           unknown_date as date_of_birth, unknown_text as nationality, unknown_text as country_iso_code,
           unknown_text as country_name, unknown_integer as height_in_centimeters, unknown_float as height_in_inches,
           unknown_text as career_wins_vs_losses, unknown_float as career_win_ratio, unknown_integer as num_of_wins,
           unknown_integer as num_of_losses
      from ref_unknown_record
)
select * from unknown_record
;

-- models/mart/rpt_match_summary.sql
with fct as (
    select * from {{ ref('fct_match') }}
)
, dd as (
    select * from {{ ref('dim_date') }}
)
, dt as (
    select * from {{ ref('dim_tournament') }}
)
, dp_winner as (
    select * from {{ ref('dim_player') }}
)
, dp_loser as (
    select * from {{ ref('dim_player') }}
)
select dd.date_iso as "Date"
      ,dt.tournament_name as "Tournament"
      ,dt.surface as "Surface"
      ,fct.round as "Round"
      ,dp_winner.player_name as "Winner"
      ,dp_loser.player_name as "Loser"
      ,fct.score as "Score"
      ,fct.num_of_matches as "Matches"
      ,fct.winner_num_of_aces as "Aces"
      ,dd.year as "Year"
      ,dp_winner.dominant_hand as "Hand"
  from fct
  left join dd on fct.dim_tournament_date_key = dd.dim_date_key
  left join dt on fct.dim_tournament_key = dt.dim_tournament_key
  left join dp_winner on fct.dim_player_winner_key = dp_winner.dim_player_key
  left join dp_loser on fct.dim_player_loser_key = dp_loser.dim_player_key
;",
  "viz": "table",
  "outputs": ["dim_tournament", "dim_player", "rpt_match_summary"]
}
```
